title: Ordinary root tensor twist cocycle
statement: The first conclusion of lem-pur-finite-smooth-ordinary-twisted-cocycles: the ordered shifted d-fold root-line tensor comparisons obey the ordinary twist cocycle.

proof.text: Apply the proved ordinaryRootDerivedComp to the three supplied comparison records. That lemma composes the root power maps through their monic kernel inclusion, detects the ordinary adjuncts on Tate generators and applies exact degree-zero adjunction composition.

The canonical shift comparison is the mate of exact scalar restriction shift. Apply the generic proved shifted_comp helper in the endpoint-composition module to the preceding unshifted equation. This gives composition of the shifted degree-one factors. No endpoint record is assumed or constructed.

The tensor-power-zero case is the proved transported scalar unit composition theorem. For the successor use naturality of the binary tensorator and bifunctoriality to combine the induction hypothesis in the first factor with the shifted root comparison in the second factor. Binary scalar tensor coherence identifies the initial tensor comparisons. This completes the induction, without a pullback, compact-support or purity-source map.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryTwistCocycle
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (ell : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (twists : ∀ (r m : ℕ) (_hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmr : m ≤ r),
      CoefficientLineComparison (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hmr) (ell ^ r) (ell ^ m)
        (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) X) :
  ∀ (r m n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnm : n ≤ m) (hmr : m ≤ r),
    (ordinaryScalar (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hnm) X).map
        ((twists r m (hn.trans hnm) hmr).tensorPower d).hom ≫
      ((twists m n hn hnm).tensorPower d).hom =
    (ordinaryAssociator X ell hmr hnm).hom.app
        (line (coefficient ell r) (ell ^ r) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) X d) ≫
      ((twists r n hn (hnm.trans hmr)).tensorPower d).hom
